jobgether-jobgether:lever:34f9289b-dd60-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will combine rigorous research with clear, neutral, and accessible writing to help readers understand important policy debates. The role spans legislation, court cases, executive orders, policy proposals, scholarly research, and emerging developments across the country. You will contribute to both ongoing coverage and large-scale research projects, including 50-state analyses and policy trend tracking. The position also offers opportunities to create newsletters, webinars, educational resources, and other content formats. Success requires intellectual curiosity, strong judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and impartiality. Develop compelling headlines and identify the strongest or most relevant aspects of stories to improve reader engagement. Host and lead webinars, prepare presentations, and contribute to educational outreach initiatives such as Learning Journeys and Learning Expeditions. Draft and contribute to recurring newsletters and topical programming related to breaking policy developments. Interact professionally with donors, customers, media representatives, external partners, and internal stakeholders when required. Participate in team learning activities, including recurring book clubs, and attend relevant events or conferences as needed. Continuously identify opportunities to improve research methods, content quality, workflows, and the overall reader experience. Use AI tools and emerging technologies where appropriate to increase productivity, research effectiveness, and content quality. Requirements Demonstrated interest in and commitment to providing accurate, neutral, and accessible information about U.S. politics and public policy. Familiarity with the administrative state, federal rulemaking processes, and/or public assistance programs such as SNAP or Medicaid is preferred. Excellent research, writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex information into accessible content for general audiences. Strong ability to identify reliable sources, conduct efficient research, synthesize information, and recognize meaningful trends across multiple policy areas. jobgether-jobgether:lever:95a56d08-8f85-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Workforce Planning Strategy & Analytics based in Canada. This is a newly established leadership opportunity to build and shape an enterprise-wide workforce planning function from the ground up. You will develop forecasting, capacity, headcount, and scenario-planning models that connect workforce decisions with business outcomes. The role sits at the intersection of People Operations, Finance, Talent, Analytics, and business strategy. You will transform fragmented and manual planning processes into scalable systems, tools, and operating rhythms. Your analysis will directly inform executive decisions around workforce strategy, financial planning, recruitment, and organizational capacity. This is an ideal environment for a hands-on strategic leader who can build sophisticated models while confidently advising senior stakeholders. You’ll have significant ownership and influence in a fast-paced, high-growth organization. Build and lead the enterprise workforce planning function, defining its long-term vision, roadmap, frameworks, and operating model in collaboration with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders. Develop demand forecasting, headcount, capacity, and scenario-planning models that connect workforce decisions to costs, organizational capacity, and broader business outcomes. Partner closely with FP&A on headcount governance, annual budget cycles, workforce forecasting, and long-term workforce cost planning. Diagnose and redesign complex workforce planning processes, including data collection, forecasting cadences, approval workflows, and governance mechanisms. Transform manual or fragmented planning practices into scalable, repeatable, and data-driven systems. Own and continuously improve the data infrastructure, reporting, dashboards, and tools that support workforce planning and provide leadership with self-service visibility into headcount and capacity. Influence senior stakeholders across Finance, HR, Talent, and business functions to adopt new planning models, frameworks, processes, and ways of working without relying on direct authority. Translate complex workforce and business data into clear, executive-ready narratives, recommendations, and strategic insights. Establish a consistent operating rhythm for workforce planning and continuously improve the quality, accuracy, and usability of planning outputs. Requirements 6+ years of experience in FP&A, business or data analytics, management consulting, quantitative strategy, or a closely related field; direct workforce planning experience is an advantage but not mandatory. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with strong experience building sophisticated models from scratch. Proven ability to create forecasting, capacity, headcount, or scenario models using incomplete, complex, or imperfect datasets. Strong SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker are highly preferred. Demonstrated ability to identify inefficient or manual processes and replace them with scalable, structured, and repeatable solutions. Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії.
